item.content:encoded:
SCP-5127 is an anomalous object that resembles a wax figure of an unknown origin. SCP-5127 seems to be completely inanimate until it is approached by any living subject in 5 meters. If a living being enters the 5 meters seclusion zone SCP-5127 will become semi-conscious and will not return to its inanimate state until it has neutralized the subject. Attempts to interview SCP-5127 during its semi-conscious state but these attempts failed. All testing has been suspended.

Deletion at -22 and three votes.

SCP 5161 is a chamber by instances SCP 1000 on a ledge of Mt. ████████, the walls of this chamber is made of unknown materials at the moment that through past interaction proved indomitable, but appears to be granite,

Deleted at -16 and three votes.

Darkest Days

MTF-336 wakes up from break. He goes and does his usual things like getting a snack. He walks out to the hall to check his post.

"Im at 049 today? Thats strange. Never been there before…"

Deleted at -14 and three votes.

item.title: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.: Re: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.
item.content:encoded:
SCP-5368-A is an entity that infused itself with Tiger tank 132, designated as SCP-5368-B. SCP-5368-A can utilize all of SCP-5368-B's system, including its 88 mm cannon and 2× 7.92 mm MG34. SCP-5368-A also apparently has some unique abilities and characteristics as the weapons and armor on SCP-5368-B seems to be enhanced, allowing better protection and firepower. SCP-5368 is remarkably aggressive and territorial. All non-personnel must not come in contact with it. If aggravated, SCP-5368 will become hostile and attempt to destroy anything in its vicinity. All SCP Foundation personnel guarding SCP-5368 must immediately respond and engage until SCP-5368 reverts back to its passive mode, which averagely lasts from 30 minutes to 2 hours. Air support is necessary as it will presumably bring the time of aggravation down by half an hour, but still remains harmless to SCP-5368. Any non-personnel who come into contact with SCP-5368 must be given amnestics and misinformed by MTF Gamma-5.

Deleted at -16 and three votes.

SCP-5083 is a body of clear gas originally found inside of a jar located inside of a house in ██████████, Wyoming. SCP-5083 when inhaled gives off a taste of pine sap inside of the subject's mouth and a heavy feeling in the lungs.

Deleted at -15 and three votes.

item.title: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.: Re: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.
item.content:encoded:
/scp-5492 (no title) by CocoaIzBlu deleted at -20 and three votes.

SCP-5492 is a speaker-like object produced somewhere in the 1800s, probably tracing back to 1877. Object#: 5492 is a half-rotten spruce cuboid, plated with metal speakers made with aluminium. Its main colour is white due to the clear lack of pigmentation in SCP-5492's shape, making the wood hard to classify to the eye.

Feedback ported:

[+] from DoctorSasbo
– hide block

It's really unfortunate that everybody is downvoting this without actually commenting suggestions to help it. Here's my two cents:

The biggest issue with this imo is the prose:

  • "immensely scant amount of room, and heaps of soundproof foam" is not clinical enough for an official document. Try saying "an enclosed space insulated by soundproof foam", or state the measurements if you want to drive home the extent of it
  • "due to the lack of knowledge on SCP-5492" - If it's being researched, we already know there's a lack of knowledge, so the phrase is redundant
  • "somewhere in the 1800s, probably tracing back to 1877" - Firstly, I think you meant "sometime" instead of "somewhere." Secondly, if you have that specific of a year, it doesn't make sense to add uncertainty by saying "probably." Finally, you might want to briefly say where it's from/was found.
  • "Its main colour is white due to the clear lack of pigmentation in SCP-5492's shape, making the wood hard to classify to the eye" could just be "It is predominantly white." You're spending a lot of words elaborating on something that could be written more concisely.
  • "at the first glances… teeth to commit suicide." is too long of a sentence, try breaking it up into multiple sentences so the reader can more effectively process it
  • ""the noise is so dreadful it's better to die than live to remember the horror" - Which was said by a test subject." I get what you're going for, but it comes off as kinda flat and cliche. You might want to flesh it out a bit more with an interview log, so you can go more in detail about the effects on the subject.
  • "the unfathomable entity" doesn't fit the clinical tone. It's SCP-5492.
  • "When the surviving Subject made it out of the containment he was insane and instead of being suicidal he was critically homicidal instead." Instead of just saying he's homicidal, try describing what he did i.e. stab researchers, torture fellow D-class, etc.

Overall, I think this is a workable concept, but the execution is severely lacking. Tighten up your prose, and try to elaborate more on what actually happens so you can show instead of just telling. Hope this helps!

item.title: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.
item.content:encoded:
All Staff-enacted Deletions are carried out according to the Deletions Guide.

Summary deletions result for:

  • Articles with malicious intent
  • Pages that are clearly unfinished.
  • Attempts to "game" site procedure, such as re-posting a non-rewritten article in an attempt to get around downvotes.
  • Blatantly plagiarized material.
  • An article posted outside of the current range.

If an author attempts to self-delete their work and fails to do so properly, including either by blanking the page or renaming it, it will be deleted properly by Staff.

item.title: Community Outreach Junior Staff Recruitment - Applications OPEN: Re: Community Outreach Junior Staff Recruitment - Introductions Sub-team
item.content:encoded:
Hey there! I've been interested in doing this for quite some time now, so here goes nothing! :)

► Application info
▼ Application info

Why do you want to be a junior staff on Community Outreach?

I would like to join the Community Outreach Team to help people find their way around the sometimes confusing nature of the Wiki and the SCP Universe itself.

I believe that the SCP Wiki is the most impressive collaborative effort even undertaken by people on the internet - a place born out of passion and pure creativity - and I would like to help make this wonderful thing as good as it can possibly be. I've seen too many people get turned-off on being invested in all stuff-SCP after a couple of moments within the community due to confusion about certain parts of it or just a general feeling of being overwhelmed, and I would love to do my best to prevent that sort of events from happening.

I try to be involved in as many community events as I can - from contests to the Art Exchange - I would love to help to organize such. Bringing this massive community together in new ways that would make people excited for all content SCP-wise would be a dream.

How active are you?

I'm active on-site every single day - although my activity is mostly focused during afternoon and evening hours, I try to keep in touch with the community whenever and however I can. Additionally, I am very active on SCP-related Discord servers, such as Dr. Cimmerian's Discord Server, /r/SCPDeclassified Discord Server, and Site-42 Discord Server - I engage with conversations going on in such almost constantly throughout the day. I try to read and give idea/draft critique on the said platform to every single request I can possibly put in my schedule - anyone who wishes to obtain help in any way related to the SCP Universe or writing for such can find it within my DMs or in the mentioned servers by simply @-ing me.

Additionally, I read a lot. Unless I'm really busy (which doesn't happen very often), I try to read almost every single article showing up on the Newly Created Pages thread. I also check up on the O5 Command forums once in a while to see how staff functions since these topics have always interested me.

Thought most of my activity circles around Discord due to its relative ease in access on both PC and mobile, I also try to reply to as many Idea Critique and Draft Critique as I possibly can on-site and on IRC when I have a free day - though I'm not a frequent user of the second platform, whenever I enter it, I am more than happy to help people with their writing and/or questions about the SCP Universe.

How can we contact you? Wikidot, IRC, and/or Discord?

As mentioned previously, the place I'm most active on is Discord - I go there by Kein#5142; when contacted there, I am going to reply within 1-2 hours unless I'm currently sleeping (my timezone is GMT+1). I will also notice all Wikidot messages since I check any and all sent to me regularly. IRC is not really my thing, so it isn't the most efficient place to contact me, but I will pop-in to check things out there once every couple of days.

Edit: I have heavily familiarized myself with IRC since the creation of this message; throughout the next couple of days, I will be trying to implement it as heavily as Discord into my lifestyle, spending equal amounts of time on both platforms.

If there are any more questions, I would be more than happy to clear things up. Thanks for considering me!
